goal: Estimate memory used by block templates held by external mining clients
Prevent unmonitored memory bloat from evicted mempool transactions pinned by templates
agreement: Strong substantive support across rebases with no open objections
Verified in mainnet testing with an sv2-tp client over 20 hours (xyzconstant)
Approved after adding shutdown safety fixes and non-fatal checks (ryanofsky)
Past objections around thread safety, memory tracking, and shutdown races resolved

categories.name: mining
why: P2 because it lets Stratum v2 template providers monitor pinned transaction memory
Gives node operators and clients visibility into memory held on behalf of mining clients
